input.summary: Yaba Market Store — Dry Goods shelf. Two planogram SKUs read as stocked out: Indomie Onion Chicken 120g and Golden Penny Spaghetti 500g. Inventory check shows both are well stocked in the store (14 and 19 units, both far above their reorder point of 6), so the fix is a shelf refill from the backroom, not a purchase order. No reorders were created. Two other SKUs are at or below reorder point (Dangote Spaghetti 500g: 2 on hand; Golden Penny Semovita 1kg: 4 on hand) but the audit shows them fully faced on shelf; given the unreliable photo I have not ordered against them and have asked the manager to confirm counts during the visit. No telemetry and no equipment fault, so no technician dispatched. A manager has been notified by WhatsApp with the refill list. Action for the manager: refill Onion Chicken to 3 facings and Golden Penny Spaghetti to 4 facings, and verify on-hand counts for Dangote Spaghetti and Semovita.
